additive.qualification: Singleton h and F(1),G_H retained exactly on each configuration; this tests mixed interactions, not an independent prediction of all C.

limitations: Finite off-schedule diagnostic only; it does not establish a cofinal estimate or improve CF22.
The exact F(1) and G_H values are retained as oracle components in the frozen baselines.
The attachment discloses approximate U48/U64 mask coefficients; those are not blind coefficient holdouts.
Heldout configurations test frozen full-return baselines and receive no fitting or tuning.

source_specialization.raw_sum: complete disk 0<Norm(w)<=B; exact periodic character-pair sums
